body.statement: Using the causal residual-distinguishability handle, characterize \(\rho(h)\): are the \(B_h\) equality partitions pairwise distinguishable by legal causal suffixes and terminal normalized conjunctions, or is there a uniformly coarser exact continuation quotient? In the latter case, derive the resulting improved single-conjunction runtime; in the former case, certify the \(B_h\) state lower bound without claiming an \(h\log h\) time lower bound.
body.justification: Sufficiency leaves open the mathematically sharper question of the coarsest exact causal continuation state.
body.gap: Darwiche--Marquis provide general succinctness methodology and Rossetto--Antonucci request finer quotients, but no causal Myhill--Nerode frontier for these normalized \(h\)-world residuals is known from the inspected literature.
body.consumer: A minimality theorem would certify the state representation, while a coarsening would immediately improve every compiled sharp-bound query in the class.
